scientific_intent.scientific_task: Evaluate density/volume algebra, material-specific pressure-like algebra and same-material inverse-distance neighborhood terms on a Cartesian cell grid. This is a multi-material continuum computation proxy, not a complete PDE timestep, equation-of-state calibration or validated physical simulation.

Original includes zero-distance self and is nonfinite; explicitly corrected secondary excludes self. The latter is NOT normalized inverse-distance weighting.
